messages:
Aisha_support: QuillForge just reported 403s after onboarding. They say console shows an API key but all requests get `403: access_denied`. Can someone look?

Devon_se: on it. Do we have the customer org id and sample key?

Aisha_support: Org: quillforge-prod (org_8291). Key visible in console as `rk_live_ABC123` but CLI shows it under project `svc-provisioner-4321` not their project.

Maya_onboard: hmm that's suspicious — could be the provisioner service routing to our internal project when the org mapping isn't present. Any provisioning logs? infra-bot, could you paste the claim run?

infra-bot: provisioning claim received: claim_id=clm-9983, org_hint=quillforge-prod, provisioner=svc-provisioner, created_key=rk_live_ABC123, assigned_project=svc-provisioner-4321, billing_account=null

Devon_se: billing_account=null — that will cause the key to be inactive for public API usage (we require billing link for hosted keys). Looks like two issues: 1) key landed in internal service project, 2) billing not linked. Both explain 403.

Aisha_support: customer says they completed SAML sign-in and accepted terms. They used company SSO (Okta). Could SAML attributes be missing project claim?

Maya_onboard: yes, if the SAML assertion didn't include `project_id` we fallback to provisioner default. There's a race where the new org-mapper service didn't return mapping before the provisioner timed out and used fallback. Related bug filed: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4567

Devon_se: repro steps I used locally:
```
# simulate SAML assert without project claim
$ ri-provision --org quillforge-prod --saml-assertion ./samples/no-project-assert.json
Provisioning... -> assigned_project=svc-provisioner-4321
Key created: rk_live_ABC123
```

Devon_se: CLI `ri-admin get-key --id rk_live_ABC123 --verbose` output:
```
key.id: rk_live_ABC123
owner.org: quillforge-prod (org_8291)
project: svc-provisioner-4321
status: active_in_console but blocked_for_api (billing_missing)
created_by: provisioner@infra
```

Maya_onboard: quick mitigation: we can reassign the key to the correct project and link billing. Commands (admin required):
```
# reassign key to customer's project
$ ri-admin reassign-key --key rk_live_ABC123 --project quillforge-prod-prod-9001
# attach billing account
$ ri-admin link-billing --org quillforge-prod --billing acct-BILL-9001
```

Aisha_support: can we run that now? Customer is blocked in prod.

Devon_se: I'll run reassign and link billing after getting approval from ops. Will paste logs.

onboard-bot: Claim clm-9983 status -> resolved (rebind_requested) by devon_se at 1746354402

Devon_se: reassign completed:
```
2024-11-02T14:00:05Z reassign-key rk_live_ABC123 -> quillforge-prod-prod-9001 OK
2024-11-02T14:00:07Z link-billing org=quillforge-prod acct=acct-BILL-9001 OK
```

Aisha_support: customer confirmed calls now succeed, thanks! They hit a 200 on the previously failing endpoint. :tada:

Maya_onboard: follow-up: patch to provisioner to wait for org-mapper up to 3s before fallback is in review (PR #4672). We should also add an observability alert when billing_account is null after key creation.

Devon_se: created internal ticket INF-4567 (root cause) and INF-4678 (monitoring rule). Leaving notes on the customer's support case.

Aisha_support: closing on Slack thread, moving to case notes. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
